payload.name: Conspicuous Omni-Signaling
payload.fact: Conspicuous omni-signaling is a phenomenon where consumers use both offline and online media to signal conspicuous consumption in a hybrid manner.

decision_note: NOT_TRANSFERABLE — rejected as a batch because the corpus concentration, not any one claim, is the finding: 3 of these 11 proposals cite the SAME single source (10.1002/cb.70189, smartphone battery depletion) and 3 more cite ANOTHER single source (10.1086/673256, luxury handbag signaling) — 6 of 11 are near-duplicate readings of two papers. This is a corpus coverage defect, not a per-claim transferability judgment; logged separately that ST-09 needs re-harvest, not further review, before its next batch.
